messages.content: Extract factual decree evidence only, without deciding whether section 7703(a)(2) applies. Identify the queried person and year. Preserve the direction individual-to-spouse and accept only a decree of divorce or separate maintenance. Use closed_interval only with a supported ending date, effective_through_close only when the text or native case semantics supports that the decree remained effective through December 31 of the queried year, and onset_only when only its effective date is supported. A dated event alone must not be extended arbitrarily into future years. Mark the decree channel resolved only after inspecting all supplied facts and extracting its finite set; otherwise mark it unknown. Return nonempty verbatim current witnesses and describe unresolved or unlowerable factual evidence.
